query:
select
display_id as "Patient ID",
first_name as "First name",
last_name as "Last name",
sex as "Sex",
village as "Village",
age as "Age",
to_char(date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of birth",
to_char(
((triage_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
) as "Time of triage",
triage_category as "Triage category",
arrival_mode as "Arrival mode",
chief_complaint as "Chief complaint",
secondary_complaint as "Secondary complaint",
diagnoses as "Diagnoses",
medications as "Medications",
to_char(
((active_care_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
) as "Time of active care/admission",
case
when triage_datetime is not null and active_care_datetime is not null and active_care_datetime >= triage_datetime
then concat(
lpad((
extract(day from (active_care_datetime - triage_datetime)) * 24
+ extract(hour from (active_care_datetime - triage_datetime))
)::text, 2, '0'), ':',
lpad(extract(minute from (active_care_datetime - triage_datetime))::text, 2, '0'), ':',
lpad((extract(second from (active_care_datetime - triage_datetime))::int)::text, 2, '0')
)
end
as "Waiting time triage to active care (hh:mm:ss)",
target_time_met as "Target time met",
ed_outcome as "Discharged from ED or admitted",
discharge_disposition as "Discharge disposition",
to_char(
((discharge_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
) as "Discharge date and time",
case
when triage_datetime is not null and discharge_datetime is not null and discharge_datetime >= triage_datetime
then concat(
lpad((
extract(day from (discharge_datetime - triage_datetime)) * 24
+ extract(hour from (discharge_datetime - triage_datetime))
)::text, 2, '0'), ':',
lpad(extract(minute from (discharge_datetime - triage_datetime))::text, 2, '0'), ':',
lpad((extract(second from (discharge_datetime - triage_datetime))::int)::text, 2, '0')
)
end
as "Total length of stay triage to discharge (hh:mm:ss)"
from "reporting"."ds__emergency_triage"
where
-- BL-011: the facility is selectable. There is deliberately no department filter -- a
-- triage record is itself the evidence the encounter came through emergency, so the
-- register covers every such encounter regardless of where it moved afterwards.
case
when 
:facilityId is null then true
else facility_id = 
:facilityId
end
-- BL-014: the triage category is selectable
and case
when 
:triageScore is null then true
else score = 
:triageScore
end
-- BL-012: the date range filters on the date of triage, inclusive of both bounds
and ((triage_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))::date
>= 
:fromDate
and ((triage_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))::date
<= 
:toDate
order by triage_datetime
name: Emergency triage line list
notes:
This report generates a list of emergency department presentations triaged within the selected date range, one row per triage record, in order of triage time.

For each presentation the report includes the triage category and arrival mode, the chief and secondary complaint, any diagnoses and medications recorded during the encounter, and the times of triage and of the start of active care.

'Waiting time triage to active care' is the interval between triage and the time the triage record was closed, shown as total hours, minutes and seconds (hh:mm:ss). A stay longer than a day appears as, for example, 29:28:00.

'Target time met' compares that waiting time against the target for the patient's triage category. Targets default to Australasian Triage Scale intervals, with a 2-minute allowance for Category 1 rather than literal 'immediate' (Category 2 within 10 minutes, Category 3 within 30, Category 4 within 60, Category 5 within 120), and are configured per deployment. The column is blank while a patient is still waiting.

'Discharged from ED or admitted' shows 'Admitted' where the encounter went on to an inpatient admission, and 'Discharged' where the encounter has ended. It is blank while the encounter is still open. A death in the department is not reported as a separate outcome -- the discharge disposition column carries it.

'Total length of stay' runs from triage to the end of the encounter, so for an admitted patient it spans the whole inpatient episode.
